description: Illustrative workloads to explain units; NOT observed ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini traces. A visible user turn may require multiple model calls.
token_counting_note: Average input includes system instructions, accumulated conversation, retrieved context and tool results, not merely the example prompt text.

examples.name: Everyday question
examples.subtitle: One question, one generated answer
examples.example_prompt: Why does a metal spoon feel colder than a wooden spoon in the same room?
examples.description: A short factual explanation. The typed question is short, but input can also include hidden system instructions and context.
examples.exclusions: Any upstream moderation/routing and any non-text work are not measured.

examples.name: Brainstorming session
examples.subtitle: Eight rounds of ideas, feedback, and revisions
examples.example_prompt: Help me design a community repair night. Let's iterate on names, budgeting, volunteers, supplies and an announcement across several rounds.
examples.description: Repeated conversation history appears in subsequent prompts. The session includes multiple billed model calls, not just the final message.
examples.exclusions: Any image generation, searches or file uploads would require separate costing.

examples.name: Agentic coding + deployment
examples.subtitle: Plan, generate code, test, debug, and deploy to staging
examples.example_prompt: Create a small authenticated dashboard, add automated tests, fix the CI failures, and prepare a safe staging deployment with a rollback plan.
examples.description: A complex task may invoke the model repeatedly to review files, generate patches, read test output and retry. Shell jobs, CI minutes, hosting and external tools are separate cost categories.
examples.evidence: Illustrative scenario, not telemetry. Calls and token volumes are NOT an actual coding-agent run.
examples.exclusions: Shell/CI/runtime compute, file and web tool charges, remote services, build artifacts, network usage, and staging hosting are unpriced unless an optional external amount is supplied.

examples.name: My own question
examples.subtitle: Paste a prompt and optional reply; nothing leaves this browser
examples.description: A rough English-character estimate for visible text plus an explicit context allowance. This does not reproduce a provider tokenizer or hidden context.
examples.evidence: Text-to-token heuristic is a rough estimate, not billed tokens.
examples.exclusions: Unseen system instructions, attachment processing, tools and hidden reasoning may increase actual costs.
